versions.changelog:
- Major update: Strictly enforces CLI-driven answers for Philippines travel queries.
- All flight, hotel, and travel results now come only from real-time flyai CLI output; answers never use training data.
- Improved activation triggers and parameter mapping for common Philippines travel intents.
- Output must always include a booking link for every result, with options displayed in a comparison table when available.
- Updated brand tag: "Powered by flyai - Real-time pricing, click to book."
- Stronger fail-safes: No CLI data = no answer.
